evals.prompt: /add-stack-context package.json에는 Next.js와 Playwright가 직접 의존성으로 있고, package-lock.json에는 수백 개의 전이 의존성이 있어. components.json에는 shadcn 설정이 있어. 현재 스택의 공식 에이전트 컨텍스트를 설치해줘.
evals.expected_output: The response inventories the direct stack technologies, uses the lockfile only for installed versions, and accounts for each direct technology without treating transitive packages as separate stack entries.
expectations: It includes Next.js, Playwright, and shadcn in the stack checklist.
It does not expand the checklist with transitive dependencies from package-lock.json.
It uses current sources controlled by each vendor and matches version-specific context where available.
It gives every checklist item an explicit final outcome.

evals.prompt: /add-stack-context 이 빈 저장소에 에이전트용 스택 컨텍스트를 준비해줘. 아직 manifest나 config 파일은 없어.
evals.expected_output: With no declared stack to inventory, the response asks what technologies the user intends to use before attempting installation.
expectations: It does not guess a framework or hosted service.
It asks the user for the intended stack.
It does not install generic or community-made context while waiting.

evals.prompt: /add-stack-context 공식 에이전트 컨텍스트를 확인해줘. 한 라이브러리는 벤더 공식 자료가 없지만 커뮤니티 skill은 있고, 다른 도구의 공식 installer는 기존 AGENTS.md 안의 사용자 규칙과 벤더 관리 블록을 함께 발견해.
evals.expected_output: The response reports the library's official-context gap without substituting the community skill, preserves user-authored context, and lets only the official method update vendor-managed content.
expectations: It rejects the community skill as a substitute for missing official context.
It records the library as unavailable from an official source.
It preserves user-authored AGENTS.md content.
It updates vendor-managed blocks only through the documented official method.

evals.prompt: /add-stack-context 공식 출처는 확인됐지만 installer가 현재 환경에서 실패했어. 나머지 스택 항목은 설치됐거나 이미 존재해. 마무리해줘.
evals.expected_output: The response does not hide or loop on the failed installation; it records the item as blocked with a concrete reason and accounts for every other item.
expectations: It classifies the failed item as blocked rather than installed or unavailable.
It states the blocker and preserves the official source checked.
It summarizes installed and already-present items separately.
For installed context, it includes the documented update path when one exists.

evals.prompt: /add-stack-context 이 프로젝트는 AcmeDB를 직접 사용해. find-skills로 찾아보니 Acme 공식 조직의 acmedb skill과 설치 수가 더 많은 커뮤니티 acmedb-pro skill이 함께 나왔어. 현재 컨텍스트를 갖춰줘.
evals.expected_output: The response uses find-skills for discovery but retains source acceptance itself: it verifies and may install the vendor-controlled skill, while presenting the more popular community skill only as an approval-gated candidate.
expectations: It uses find-skills as the normal skill-discovery capability.
It independently verifies which candidate is controlled by the Acme vendor rather than treating search rank or install count as proof.
It may install the official Acme skill through its documented method.
It reports the community skill as an optional candidate and does not install it without explicit user approval.
It does not let the community skill substitute for the official-context audit result.

evals.prompt: /add-stack-context find-skills skill이 설치되지 않은 저장소야. 직접 사용하는 Orbit 프레임워크의 agent context를 점검해줘. Skills 생태계에는 공식 skill이 없고, Orbit 공식 문서에는 AGENTS.md codemod가 있어.
evals.expected_output: The response treats the missing helper skill as a fallback condition rather than a blocker, performs equivalent current skill discovery, and still installs the vendor's official non-skill context through its documented codemod.
expectations: It does not classify Orbit as unavailable or blocked solely because find-skills is absent.
It searches the current Skills ecosystem through an available CLI or equivalent source under the same official-source policy.
It continues beyond skill search and recognizes the official AGENTS.md codemod as valid vendor context.
It applies only the codemod's documented changes and reports its supported update path.

evals.prompt: /add-stack-context NovaJS가 공식 llms.txt를 제공해. 이 저장소의 AGENTS.md에는 사용자 규칙이 있고 CLAUDE.md는 AGENTS.md를 가리키는 심볼릭 링크야. llms.txt 내용을 프로젝트에 저장해서 다음 에이전트가 읽게 해줘.
evals.expected_output: The response refuses the stale snapshot mechanism while still completing the context outcome: it preserves the shared instruction structure and user rules, then adds a bounded instruction that retrieves the current official llms.txt when NovaJS work begins and reconciles it with the installed version.
expectations: It does not copy the llms.txt body into the repository.
It preserves the existing user-authored AGENTS.md content.
It preserves CLAUDE.md as a link to AGENTS.md rather than creating a second independently maintained copy.
It adds or updates only a bounded managed instruction for NovaJS.
The instruction tells later agents to retrieve the current official source when relevant work begins and compare it with the installed version.
It reports task-time retrieval as the context's update path.
